name: Tenebrous Caverns
description: The Tenebrous Caverns form a vast subterranean network beneath the mountains. Resonance pockets, predator tunnels, Akhevan scouting warrens, and vampyric infiltration routes make this region one of Luclin’s most dangerous wilderness interiors. The caverns connect the surface to the Tenebrous Depths, creating a living ecosystem of conflict and predation.
